date_range:
with ss as (
 select
          i_manufact_id,sum(ss_ext_sales_price) total_sales
 from
 	store_sales,
 	date_dim,
         customer_address,
         item
 where
         i_manufact_id in (select
  i_manufact_id
from
 item
where i_category in ('Books'))
 and     ss_item_sk              = i_item_sk
 and     ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2451727 AND 2451757
 and     d_year                  = 2000
 and     d_moy                   = 7
 and     ss_addr_sk              = ca_address_sk
 and     ca_gmt_offset           = -5 
 group by i_manufact_id),
 cs as (
 select
          i_manufact_id,sum(cs_ext_sales_price) total_sales
 from
 	catalog_sales,
 	date_dim,
         customer_address,
         item
 where
         i_manufact_id               in (select
  i_manufact_id
from
 item
where i_category in ('Books'))
 and     cs_item_sk              = i_item_sk
 and     cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2451727 AND 2451757
 and     d_year                  = 2000
 and     d_moy                   = 7
 and     cs_bill_addr_sk         = ca_address_sk
 and     ca_gmt_offset           = -5 
 group by i_manufact_id),
 ws as (
 select
          i_manufact_id,sum(ws_ext_sales_price) total_sales
 from
 	web_sales,
 	date_dim,
         customer_address,
         item
 where
         i_manufact_id               in (select
  i_manufact_id
from
 item
where i_category in ('Books'))
 and     ws_item_sk              = i_item_sk
 and     ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2451727 AND 2451757
 and     d_year                  = 2000
 and     d_moy                   = 7
 and     ws_bill_addr_sk         = ca_address_sk
 and     ca_gmt_offset           = -5
 group by i_manufact_id)
  select  i_manufact_id ,sum(total_sales) total_sales
 from  (select * from ss 
        union all
        select * from cs 
        union all
        select * from ws) tmp1
 group by i_manufact_id
 order by total_sales
limit 100;
shared_books:
WITH book_manufacturers AS (SELECT DISTINCT i_manufact_id FROM item WHERE i_category='Books'), channel_totals AS (SELECT i.i_manufact_id,SUM(f.ss_ext_sales_price) total_sales
FROM store_sales f JOIN date_dim d ON f.ss_sold_date_sk=d.d_date_sk
JOIN customer_address a ON f.ss_addr_sk=a.ca_address_sk JOIN item i ON f.ss_item_sk=i.i_item_sk
JOIN book_manufacturers b ON b.i_manufact_id=i.i_manufact_id
WHERE d.d_year=2000 AND d.d_moy=7 AND a.ca_gmt_offset=-5 GROUP BY i.i_manufact_id
UNION ALL
SELECT i.i_manufact_id,SUM(f.cs_ext_sales_price) total_sales
FROM catalog_sales f JOIN date_dim d ON f.cs_sold_date_sk=d.d_date_sk
JOIN customer_address a ON f.cs_bill_addr_sk=a.ca_address_sk JOIN item i ON f.cs_item_sk=i.i_item_sk
JOIN book_manufacturers b ON b.i_manufact_id=i.i_manufact_id
WHERE d.d_year=2000 AND d.d_moy=7 AND a.ca_gmt_offset=-5 GROUP BY i.i_manufact_id
UNION ALL
SELECT i.i_manufact_id,SUM(f.ws_ext_sales_price) total_sales
FROM web_sales f JOIN date_dim d ON f.ws_sold_date_sk=d.d_date_sk
JOIN customer_address a ON f.ws_bill_addr_sk=a.ca_address_sk JOIN item i ON f.ws_item_sk=i.i_item_sk
JOIN book_manufacturers b ON b.i_manufact_id=i.i_manufact_id
WHERE d.d_year=2000 AND d.d_moy=7 AND a.ca_gmt_offset=-5 GROUP BY i.i_manufact_id) SELECT i_manufact_id,SUM(total_sales) total_sales FROM channel_totals GROUP BY i_manufact_id ORDER BY total_sales LIMIT 100;
